quizzes.title: Social Battery
quizzes.hook: How much people can you actually handle?

low.title: The Quiet Core
low.description: Your energy tends to recover in quiet spaces. You can enjoy people, but too much social input drains you quickly.

mid.title: The Selective Social
mid.description: You enjoy connection when the context feels right. Your social energy depends heavily on the people, place and mood.

high.title: The Human Charger
high.description: Interaction often gives you momentum. You tend to recharge through people, activity and shared experiences.

questions.text: After a full day around people, what do you want most?
A free Saturday appears. Your first instinct?
At a party where you know almost nobody...
How do group chats usually feel?

strengths: You often know how to operate from the “SOLITUDE” side of this dimension.
watchOuts: Under stress, this preference can become too rigid.
everydayLife: Your energy tends to recover in quiet spaces. You can enjoy people, but too much social input drains you quickly.
low.reflection: Where did this tendency help you recently, and where did it limit you?

strengths: You can usually move between “SOLITUDE” and “SOCIAL ENERGY” depending on context.
watchOuts: Balance can sometimes turn into hesitation when priorities are unclear.

mid.title: The Integrator
mid.description: You naturally combine analysis and feeling. You can switch between evidence and intuition depending on what is at stake.

high.title: The Intuitive Heart
high.description: Your internal sense of what feels right strongly shapes your choices. Human impact often matters more than perfect logic.

quizzes.title: Overthinker
quizzes.hook: Does your brain ever actually switch off?

low.description: You usually process what matters and move forward. Uncertainty may bother you, but it rarely keeps your mind trapped for long.

mid.title: The Analyzer
mid.description: You think deeply and often replay important situations. Analysis helps you, though it can occasionally become mental noise.

high.title: The Infinite Loop
high.description: Your mind generates branches, alternatives and second-order consequences almost automatically. Switching off can be harder than deciding.

quizzes.title: Risk Taker
quizzes.hook: How far outside certainty will you go?

low.title: The Strategist
low.description: You prefer asymmetric bets: protect the downside first, then move. Security and predictability carry real value for you.

mid.title: The Calculated Risk
mid.description: You will take meaningful risks when the upside is justified. You are neither reckless nor automatically conservative.

high.title: The Edge Seeker
high.description: Uncertainty can feel energizing rather than threatening. When something matters, you are often willing to move before certainty arrives.
